sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Kashmiri Green Meenakari Floral Kundan Bracelet Watch
sourceNotes.rawContent: Delicate yet deeply traditional — this charming Kashmiri bracelet watch features diamond-shaped green meenakari panels with hand-painted pink floral motifs and sparkling kundan accents, framing a clean gold-tone quartz dial. Ghungroo bells add a playful jingle to every move. Lightweight, beautifully crafted, and perfect for ethnic fusion looks, festive gatherings, and gifting to someone special.
